name: Insider Threat Investigation
description: Investigation playbook for suspected insider threat — data exfiltration, privilege abuse, or sabotage. Requires close coordination with HR and Legal.

data.label: Engage Legal & HR
data.description: Brief Legal and HR before any investigation action. Establish scope, legal authority, and confidentiality requirements. Do NOT alert the suspect.

data.label: Preserve Evidence
data.description: Place a legal hold on email, cloud storage, and endpoint data. Capture access logs before retention expires. Hash all collected evidence.

data.label: Review Access Logs
data.description: Analyse DLP, CASB, VPN, Active Directory, and file server logs. Look for unusual after-hours access, bulk downloads, or USB usage.

data.label: Revoke Access Immediately
data.description: Disable account, revoke VPN certificates, invalidate SSO tokens, and remove privileged group memberships. Coordinate timing with Legal.

data.label: Quantify Data Loss
data.description: Identify data classification, volume, and recipients. Assess regulatory exposure (GDPR, PCI, HIPAA). Prepare breach notification analysis.

data.label: Covert Monitoring
data.description: With Legal approval, deploy enhanced monitoring on the suspect's activity. Document all observations with timestamps.

data.label: Involve Law Enforcement
data.description: Preserve chain of custody for all evidence. Provide forensic packages to law enforcement. Do not destroy evidence.

data.label: HR Action & Offboarding
data.description: Coordinate disciplinary action with HR. Execute secure offboarding: collect corporate devices, revoke all access, debrief without alerting peers.

data.label: Remediate & Harden
data.description: Rotate credentials the suspect had access to. Review and tighten least-privilege policies. Enable DLP rules. Audit shared accounts.

data.label: Document & Report
data.description: Produce confidential incident report for Legal and executives. Include timeline, evidence summary, impact assessment, and corrective actions.
